rows.grounds: compound of siddhi, attainment, root, and kaula

items.question: What is the root Kaula attainment of eight siddhis for the fair-faced goddess?
items.inference: The verse links eight siddhis to root Kaula attainment.
uncertainties: Exact doctrinal enumeration of eight siddhis is not supplied.
items.plain_english: Eight, and the attainment of siddhis, is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
